test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the largest deposits of jet black granite?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Karnataka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• There are **1.10 million tonnes of Jet Black granite **in the **Kollegal region **of **Karnataka, **which is split across **Chamarajanagar, Mysore, **and** Mandya districts. **
 
• **Jet Black granite** is used for flooring, decorative stones, and landscaping and is highly sought-after in the **US, European,** and **Chinese markets**.
 
• **Karnataka** was the leading **exporter** of **granite before 1992,** with a share of **more than 50% of all exports**.
 
• However, from **1993 to 1994, **quarrying was prohibited in the **Kollegal** region due to the operations of the** forest brigand Veerappan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Granite** is in high demand on the** international market **in the forms of **rough-cuts, bush-hammered and charred slabs**, paving tiles, wall panelling, stair treads and bathroom/kitchen unit tops.
 
• The state's granite potential has mainly gone untapped.
 
• The demand for granite ornaments is increasing internationally.
 
• Some of the strongest and most resilient stones in the world may be found in the **charmokites of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.**
